title: Wave-X True Wireless Buds, Bluetooth 5.3 Earbuds with ENC Noise Cancelling | Smart Touch Sensor | 50 H Music Time | High-Fidelity Sound Earphones for Lightning & Android Device (Blue)
description: Experience Sound in Gold. The PATTLE WAWEX True Wireless Buds combine high-fashion aesthetics with cutting-edge audio technology. Wrapped in a stunning, mirror-finish gold charging case, these earbuds are designed for those who want their tech to make a statement. Beyond the looks, the WAWEX is engineered for performance. Featuring Bluetooth 5.3 for a rock-solid connection and ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation) technology, your music stays crisp and your calls remain crystal clear, even in noisy environments. With intuitive Smart Touch Sensors, you can manage your playlist and take calls without ever reaching for your phone. Elevate your daily audio experience with the perfect blend of luxury and logic.
